system.description: VAMPIRE BLOOD POOL: The vampire's expertise rating is equal to its Blood Pool. A Blood Pool token begins on space S for a vampire or space 4 for a vampire thrall. For each {Dm} a vampire uses, move its Blood Pool token left 1 space. With a Blood Pool of 8+, a vampire gains +2 on all its attacks. A character's Attacks and Beguile action gain: RISE AGAIN! If their master is nearby or the location is full of dark power, place a token on space 0 whenever an undead falls. At the end of the round, advance each token 1 space. If the undead were summoned but their summoners are dead or further than long range, the token does not advance. Roll 1D10. When a token reaches space 4 or 7, on a result of 7-10, the undead rises again. After rolling for a token that reaches space 4 or 7, remove it from the track. Undead with Intelligence higher than 7, may use Focus slot.
